CustomField.description: Position of the action in its SObject's execution order. Actions run in ascending order, compared character by character by Unicode value, so "10" sorts before "9" and uppercase letters sort before lowercase. Must be unique among the active actions for an SObject.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Actions for an SObject run in ascending order of this value, compared character by character. Must be unique among the active actions for the SObject.
CustomField.label: Order
